name: Nike Barcelona Kids Training Dri-Fit Strike

description.subtitle: FC Barcelona 2026 2027 Nike Short Sleeve Training Jersey - Purple
description.tagline: Train like the FCB with the Mamba mentality
description.intro: The Nike Barcelona Dri-Fit Strike children's training shirt is inspired by the connection between Kobe Bryant and FC Barcelona, ​​transferring the Mamba's competitive mentality to football. Its design combines a modern style with the performance that players need in each training session.
key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT Technology: Wicks sweat away to keep skin dry and comfortable.
Classic Fit: Regular cut that offers comfort and freedom of movement.
Lightweight, breathable fabric: Keeps you cool during intense workouts.
FC Barcelona Design: Inspired by the legacy of Kobe Bryant and the identity of the Barcelona club.
